name: Reliance Worldwide Corporation Limited
summary: Reliance Worldwide Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacture, and supply of water flow, and control and monitoring products and solutions for the plumbing and heating industries. It provides PEX press system that offers push, press, expansion, crimp, and clamp technologies; push to connect fittings, valves, and tubing; brackets; and controls and connection accessories. The company also offers plumbing and heating fittings, valves, pipes, and underfloor heating solutions; equipment support and water heater accessories; drain waste and vent (DWV) products; secondary pipe supports, acoustic noise, and vibration plumbing solutions; sleeving and fires…
